title: PhyRoute: Voltage Screening under Feeder Reconfiguration
description: Software release v0.2.0 containing code, model arrays, numerical comparisons and manuscript sources for neural, physics-only and hybrid voltage screening on a balanced IEEE 33-bus feeder. The experiment covers 59 radial branch exchanges (15 development, 44 held out), three training/calibration runs, three test draws and nine verifier variants. It generates 1,830,000 topology-scenario cases, resolves 1,827,685 and retains explicit masks and diagnostics for 2,315 unresolved references. Newton-Raphson recovers 135 cases after the strict sweep fails. Results report unsafe approvals, false rejections and solver calls with their stated denominators. The residual model uses additional development-topology labels, which limits causal comparisons with the stale ensemble. The package includes a frozen protocol with amendments, non-pickle checkpoints, 549 evaluation CSVs, independent audits and official SVProc LaTeX manuscript sources. The companion manuscript remains an author-review draft and has not been submitted to the conference; author affiliation and contact details still require confirmation. Software release and archival deposit do not establish peer review or acceptance.
